name: Quick Notes
description: A scratchpad on your desktop with note tabs you add, rename, reorder and delete (up to 12). Renders basic markdown as you type (headings, bold, lists), saves as you type and shows a character count. Everything stays on your PC.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Tabs: + adds one, x or middle-click deletes it (with Undo), double-click renames it, drag moves it. Wrapped list items continue under their text.
